_im2faded4this_: Walter This came up on Day 9 carrying news from Stoneyford. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter This helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
anezka.sm: Nobody saw Ulrich "Owl" Anezka arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F5, and a quiet sniper under it.
berkaatilla: Marek Berkaatilla left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.

Marek Berkaatilla jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Viktor Detroit. The Concord medics will be busy. (@major_detroit313) Marek Berkaatilla joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Marek Berkaatilla shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
chickenmcnugget2025: The draft reached S-C15 on Day 9. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A bullet struck Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug below the ribs at S-C15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter "Mole" Dobremateico of the Concord (@dobremateiconstantin). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
eversonae: "You're late," said the corporal when Arno Eversonae arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Eversonae stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
ghostrider_q3f: Benedikt Ghostrider arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A round went through the rim of Benedikt Ghostrider's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Jakub Marshall of the Hegemony (@marshall_n7). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt Ghostrider helped stack spare sandbags at R-R16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
gilbertjamesthe4th: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
gsh1ngles: After 9 days of war, R-R13 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Felix "Mole" Ngles.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R13 and grazed Felix "Mole" Ngles's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Norbert "Shadow" Slush of the Hegemony (@slush2083). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix "Mole" Ngles kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
i_da_goat_fr: Severin "Mud" Goat came up on Day 10 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
keaganwilson085: At the depot, Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson had practised answering to his name. At R-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
lauri.joki: Clement "Mud" Joki arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Clement "Mud" Joki did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
vikt.02: Lucien "Ghost" Vikt came from Tannenfeld, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S10. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt has learned to walk bent double.
x0mb13_06: The old hands of T-F9 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
